entities.name: MetN methionine transporter ATPase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q38WL5 from Latilactobacillus sakei subsp. sakei.
ABC transporter ATP-binding subunit; provides energy coupling for methionine import in the MetNIQ complex.
Length 344 aa; calculated molecular mass 37.43 kDa; theoretical pI 5.82; predicted charge at pH 7 is -3.19.
Contains the ABC ATPase domain PF00005 (ABC_tran) at residues 21–169 and a C-terminal NIL domain at residues 267–340.
Curated reference annotation assigns EC 7.4.2.11 and ABC-type D-methionine transporter activity.
Reference complex contains two MetN ATPases, two MetI membrane proteins, and one MetQ substrate-binding protein; MetN is peripheral to the membrane.
Sequence contains the Walker A/P-loop motif GYSGAGKST around residues 35–43 and is consistent with ATP binding and hydrolysis.

source_tools.relevance: Exact sequence identity, sequence properties, domains, function, catalytic annotation, localization, and subunit evidence.

entities.name: Methionine import ATP hydrolysis
observations: Curated Rhea mapping supports ATP hydrolysis coupled to methionine transport: methionine(out) + ATP + H2O → methionine(in) + ADP + phosphate + H+.
Both L- and D-methionine transport reaction variants are represented in retrieved reference annotations; exact stereospecificity should not be inferred from sequence alone.

source_tools.relevance: Rhea reaction mappings and catalytic annotation for MetN homologs.

entities.name: MetNIQ methionine importer
observations: ABC uptake system comprising MetN ATPase subunits, MetI transmembrane subunits, and MetQ solute-binding protein.
MetN supplies ATP-dependent energy coupling; it is not itself a transmembrane protein.

source_tools.relevance: Curated transporter complex and localization annotation.
